settings.heading: Meet the Team
settings.intro: Rescue Retro Relics exists because of three very good dogs. Every relic we rescue helps another dog find a home.

settings.name: Bailee
settings.bio: Bailee was a Plott Hound with the biggest heart in Detroit, and the reason this shop exists. Bailee is the face of our brand and watches over every rescue we make.
settings.memorial_label: Forever our founder. In loving memory.

settings.name: Casey
settings.bio: Casey is a rescue pup who inspects every box that comes through the door (mostly for snacks). Her full story is coming soon.

settings.name: Savannah
settings.bio: Savannah is a rescue pup who makes sure every order is packed with love. Her full story is coming soon.
